display_long_description:
Apocalypse Rush Racing is a high-octane VR combat racing experience set in the ruins of an abandoned nuclear power plant, shattered by disaster and crawling with zombies. What was once a symbol of power is now a deadly battleground where speed, firepower, and survival collide.

You play as a racer recruited into a ruthless underground racing gang, risking everything in brutal races through radioactive facilities, collapsed reactors, broken cooling towers, and zombie-infested wastelands. Every track is packed with danger—from tight industrial corridors to open, debris-strewn zones where the undead roam freely.

Designed from the ground up for virtual reality, Apocalypse Rush Racing puts you directly in the driver’s seat with immersive controls, intense speed, and relentless action. Victory isn’t just about finishing first—it’s about surviving the chaos and proving you belong at the top of the apocalypse.
